sentences.en: This sort of work calls for a lot of patience.
sentences.zh: 这种工作需要极大的耐心。

sentences.en: Have patience with a friend rather than lose him forever.
sentences.zh: 要对你朋友有耐心，而不是永远失去他。

sentences.en: You should not lose your patience when dealing with kids.
sentences.zh: 在和孩子打交道时不应失去耐心。

senses.zh: 耐性, 忍耐力, 耐心坚忍, 坚持, 毅力Patience
